description: The places of a postal code (GeoNames); case, spaces and hyphens in the code are ignored. `partial` is true for the countries GeoNames gives only in part (CA, NL, GB: first part; CL, CN, AR: first digits; IE, MT: first letters; BR: major codes). 503 NOT_READY on a dataset built before the feature. Works without a key within a smaller daily free quota (100 calls per network).

code.description: Postal code to look up, up to 20 characters.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, e.g. TR.

offset.description: Number of results to skip for pagination, from 0 to 10000.

name: lookup_postal_code
title: Postal code lookup
